reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐A Vet’s Office That Truly Loves My Pitties! 🐾❤️

Finding a veterinary office where my babies are genuinely welcomed, loved, and cared for means more to me than words can express. I have been to other veterinary offices in my area where I’ve felt as though my pitties weren’t truly welcomed because of their breed, and that feeling is heartbreaking as a pet parent.

That’s why I appreciate this office so much! From the way they treat my babies to the love, compassion, and care they show them, they have made us feel welcomed and comfortable. It means everything to know that my pitties are seen for who they are and not judged by their breed.

Pit bulls deserve the same love, respect, patience, and quality of veterinary care as any other dog, and I’m so grateful to have found a team that recognizes that. ❤️🐶

Thank you for making my babies feel safe, loved, and welcomed. Your kindness and appreciation for this breed do not go unnoticed. It takes a special kind of heart to care for our babies the way you do, and I’m truly grateful to have found you!

If you’re a pittie parent looking for a veterinary office that will welcome your babies with open arms, I highly recommend this team! 🐾💕

My babies thank you 🐾🩷
Thank you!

We brought our kitten, Dolly Purrton, in for her establishment of care. They took our rescue folder to input all the data and trimmed her nails in addition to the exam.

Dr. DePew was great with her, even left the bin of treats to try and tempt Dolly to take one when she wouldn't take it out of hand.

I look forward to continuing care here.

Also affordable, they recently raised their exam rates (to still less than $70 for the exam).

Thanks Desert Rose Animal Hospital!
Thank you
Thank you
Very bad services!!!

We were looking for a Vet office that would take the time to get to know Barkley.  Help him with his anxiety at the Vet. From the minute he walked in everyone was kind and welcoming to Barkley and us. The care and kindness he received was appreciated, the next day follow up was also. Thank you. With this type of service Barkley will learn to enjoy his Vet visits.

Hello everyone, yesterday I brought my cat Olive in to Desert Rose.(For the first time) For the last few years I was previously going to North Phoenix veterinary clinic. My cat had been doing diarrhea for at least 6 months North Phoenix dragged me and my cat along for almost a year and she is still doing diarrhea. Not to mention all the tests they put her through, and wasted money.They never came up with what her diagnosis is.Yesterday I brought her in to see Dr Cassada. Within 1 hour the doctor told me what was wrong with her, prescribed her some medicine and we're going to go from there. I am beyond grateful with this veterinary clinic. First of all the doctors are Awesome, the staff it's so understandable and patient and the prices are perfect. I was so nervous bringing my cat in there for the first time. I was probably a little spastic, nervous and excited at the same time. They held my hand through everything. I am very happy that I feel comfortable with desert rose. I absolutely recommend them! You will not be disappointed.
Thank you!
I am a new customer an had a great initial visit with one of our dogs an will be bringing in the other one in a couple months for her exam. Beautiful new facility, great vets an service !
Great staff and great experience. First time visit and all went smooth. My dog can sometimes be scared of strangers and everyone there was helpful and accommodating.
Thank you
Thank you!
Thank you for the 5 stars

Dr. Ashley & Julissa were the best. Not only did they accommodate me last minute for an emergency. But, they continued to give me amazing care until my sweet baby was returned to me.

They got me into a room as soon as possible, Julissa came into the room and made sure everything was comfortable, asked me a couple of questions to get some more information. Shortly afterwards Dr. Ashley came into the room and examined my cat. We established what needs to happen and set everything up with ease!

The location is super clean and super nice. They keep it well kept. I would drive down from Scottsdale every time to get any care for my pets in the future.

They are extremely cost friendly, and they will work with you if you are having financial concerns. My family & I will be recommending this place to all of our neighbors!

Thank you once again for taking care of Melo!
They amazing and very kind and love every animal.

This vet's office was recommended to me because we had just adopted a kitten and needed vet to check over Luna.  I would highly recommend this vet. All their employees have wonderful compassion and patience with their clients.  They are all very caring and will even sit on the floor
To be level with your pet.

I will highly recommend this office to all my friends.  Staff was extremely friendly and doctor was very thorough.  I will definitely be making another appointment to discuss the supplements she has recommended for Luna. 3 of my vets have retired in the years I have been in Arizona, and I am so happy that this practice was recommended to me.
Sherill Scheiblich

Best vet clinic around. The entire staff from vets to receptionist care about the animals and the people that go to them. Exceptional at what they do as well as how they care. I wouldn’t take my boys anywhere else.

Incredible team, especially as someone who finds it very very difficult to trust a vet. Took my dog in fast, treated me gently and thoughtfully through my intense stress and anxiety, and walked me through every step of addressing his sudden infection. Even followed up of their own accord (a first for me with a vet) and they are extremely communicative too, even having a number you can text. Cannot recommend them enough.
Great vets. No issues. They are very helpful and nice. They treat both of my dogs and my dogs like them, too!
Excellent office staff. Both doctors sit on the floor with the dogs and answer our questions completely. The appointments never feel rushed. Love this veterinary office.

The staff from Alex and Jennifer were so caring and wonderful.  Dr. Casida is also very kind and loving with the animals and makes even the nervous type feel relaxed and comfortable.  We can't say enough about them.  Just like the "old school " vets that cared more about animals and people than the bottom line.  Would HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!

This very Dr is so nice! This was the first time I came to her office and the office staff was so sweet to me and my dog Teddy! Teddy isn't the healthiest dog. He has a portosystemic liver shunt and goes through times where is doesn't want to eat for a long time. Dr was amazing with him, although he's a bit standoffish(due to seeing lots of vets) but she kept trying and finally got some Teddy kisses. She really helped him, he is now eating again and I'm so happy. Thank you Desert Rose! My new vet and I couldn't be happier❤️❤️❤️
Can't wait to bring my other pets to see you guys!
Thank you!
Dr. Casida and staff were so patient and kind with my reactive pup. I am grateful to have found this vet for my boy. Thank you all!
Thank you for the 5 stars!

Amazing Vet Clinic.  Went with my friend for his aging dog.  Staff is welcoming and dialed into all the needs of your pet.  Suggested buying vet meds through goodrx to safe prices on meds.  If it wasn't an hour from my home,  I'd take my dog with no hesitation.  Awesome group.
Our 16 year old dog and all our cats 🐈 receive loving and skilled care at Desert Rose Animal Hospital.....thank you for this beautiful team of animal ❤️
Staff was really caring about my pets situation and doctor help understand her condition. Very reasonable pricing.

This was my first time at any vet for my cats in Arizona since I moved from the Midwest in June 2026. DesertRose was exceptional - I had no issues with my visit and all the employees were very friendly! Everyone was calm, not rushed and polite.

Dr. Casida and her team are the absolute best! From carefully guiding my elderly, ailing dog into an exam room, getting down on the floor with him, then helping me get him back out to the car, the team just can't be beat. Dr. Casida listens, and offers multiple options. I feared that I was taking my 10 y/o dog in to be put to sleep, due to his arthritis pain, but no. He is back on his feet, taking the meds Dr. Casida prescribed, and is improving. He's not dancing yet, but he may well be on his way there! Thank you, Desert Rose Animal Hospital! You'll be seeing the rest of the crew soon!

I felt a lump on my six-year-old female bully Bella. I called Desert Rose veterinarian at 3:30 and even though they were busy, they fit me in at 4:45 gave me the medication that I needed. The price is right they care about their patients and the patient’s parents, the animal owner you know who we are! They really care about our fur babies. I’m hooked. This is my Vet from here on out. All three of my bullies will come see Dr. Cassandra thank you Desert Rose animal Hospital. I really appreciate you taking care of my dog today and at a great price.!!!! Now here’s another visit that I also just went through today is August 11, 2026. My other dog tinker had tumors on her spleen and this Vet was able to get her in take care of the surgery and do this all for a good price and take care of my dog. There’s not enough good things I can say about this Vet. They’re an amazing amazing Vet and their price you guys you guys really need to hear me on the price. More than fair, they’re great Vet. They care about the animals as well as the owners.

This clinic is all about giving your pets the proper care and treatment. They are not out to rip you off with unnecessary tests like my old veterinary clinic 1rst pet that are all about $. Desert Roses approach is to provide proper treatment according to their assessment and that isn’t always to do a ton of test , it’s more about getting the proper treatment for the condition and most of the time it’s just simple medicine to treat the problem not scaring you into high dollar test that are not necessary as they can determine the best treatment just by proper examination’s and not over correcting an issue just to make $ . Desert Rose are the best of the best at a cost you can afford!
Very happy with this team. My puppy has gotten amazing care and everything is going great with her treatment!

We unfortunately had to help our 19 year old cross the rainbow bridge ow bridge. The staff here were nothing short of amazing. They were gentle, kind and compassionate to our situation. I e were given all the time we wanted to spend with our sweet baby. I never felt rushed. I had actually started talking through messenger with one of the employees who was amazing and I hadn’t even made the appointment yet.

10/10 recommend!
Really enjoyed our experience at Desert Rose.  The staff and Dr. were friendly and professional.  They listened to our concerns and provided solutions.  Thanks!

Compassionate and caring staff. Everyone was very friendly and helpful. Dr Casida was my fur baby’s vet at another place and I trust her completely. Prices are really affordable. I would definitely recommend Desert Rose Animal Hospital for all your pets health care.
Thank you

I am so grateful that I found Dr Casida and her outstanding staff.  Without exception, they went beyond in spending time with my miniature Poodle Annie and myself on our initial visit and then took phenomenal care of her teeth cleaning and extractions, and follow up.  I had been with corporate veterinarians and was frankly afraid to have them clean her teeth again.  Additionally, Alec at the front desk went way beyond in her kindness.
Please consider taking your precious fur babies to Desert Rose Animal Hospital as they are exceptional!

BEST VET!!! Nicest staff, very knowledgeable and affordable. They have taken such good care of all 4 of my dogs! Dr. Ashley Casida is so kind and knows exactly what to do! I have never trusted any place as much as Desert Rose Animal Hospital.
Thank you for the 5 stars
Thank you!
Great and caring service.  Desert Rose team was so thoughtful, thorough and caring.
Gave me cat the best care I could have asked for

Hands down Best Dr. Ever 💯 She listens and cares with No rush n Hon🙏st. Not money hungry. Tries to be fair on prices if it don't work tries to come up with a plan that works for you.
She did my 19 yr old baby cancer tumor twice and did a Phenomenal job. Thank u  🌹🙏for 6 yrs of dedication Also staff is awesome.
thank you
Thank you for the review!
Finally! An authentic animal practice that shows nothing but knowledge, love and integrity!! I’m telling everyone how fantastic you are, but don’t get too busy! 😉 Moby & Milo approved! …

Been to so many vets and this one is it! They treated my Lucy as if they’ve known her her whole life! The care was excellent and efficient .They actually know what they’re doing and don’t just try to hurry and get you out. Lucy gives it 5 stars!🤍 …
Great experience with my dogs. Vets are both very kind and knowledgeable. Prices are reasonable. They geniunely care and it shows. Definitely recommend!
Thank you!
Thank you!
I wish I could give more stars than just five. Highly Recommend this veterinarian team, friendly family, atmosphere, affordable low prices with excellent service.
Couldn't ask for a better experience! Staff generous and caring. Dr knowledgeable and generous as well. Fabulous!

Dr Cas entire staff were friendly and personable. They treated my baby girl with compassion and kindness.
Doctor explained in detail her diagnosis and what to expect moving forward.
She has great communication skills!

Desert Rose is a wonderful clinic! My dog and I felt very welcome and prices were affordable. The doctor didn’t try to upsell us or do any unnecessary test. My dog is feeling much better and we will be back.

My old man has been having some internal issue for awhile and I have been procrastinating taking him to see a vet as I was expecting a 1-2k vet bill for all of the testing. This place was recommended and I was told it’s affordable and it absolutely is! Not only are the techs and the vet so kind but you can truly tell they love animals. I wasn’t worried one bit with how they’d handle my dog in the back and I was told he made a good handful of friends he didn’t want to leave. Koda and I appreciate you guys so much and will continue to come in as he ages for any issues that may occur in the future!

Thank you for your getting Molly in the same day to get her assessment and for scheduling her for surgery the following day (bladder stones).  She is recovering very well and is back to her sweet, happy self. From our whole family: Thank you Desert Rose Animal Hospital❤️
Great staff…very helpful and kind.

Dr Ashley was knowledgeable, explained well, was great with my senior fear dog and took the time to advise options that were right for him. Even offering to go above and beyond for him. Pricing was realistic so patients could receive the care they need. THANK YOU !!!
Very kind staff for my nervous dog and treatment options - no hard sell.

I was devastated when my vet closed his doors in December of last year. I rescued two kitties in February and I was forced to look for another vet. Never fun. But then I found Desert Rose. When I brought Malcolm in first, the staff and doctors were so inviting, helpful, knowledgeable and compassionate. The doctors and tech were so patient. They answered all of my questions without making me feel rushed. I found my new vet home!! Thank you so much!! 😁
Thank you!
Best vet in town!!!!

We will never go anywhere else with our beloved animals. Dr. Casida is beyond compare-and she ensures only the best of the best stand in her place when she is unavailable. With a pet emergency (IVDD) we received nothing but compassion and support. When we had to make a difficult decision we were provided a space that made it clear they understand our pets are family. Truly the best experience I've had in decades of owning dogs. (Note: I've also never experienced such reasonable prices for their incredibly high level of care.)

May 2026 Update:  As soon as we brought home our new family member, the first thing I did was make an appointment with Desert Rose Animal Hospital.... I'd never trust my pets to anyone else!!

We could not feel more *grateful* that we found Desert Rose when we did! Dr. Casida made a world of difference-- we had the peace of mind and gut feeling (after a very emotional string of days) that our dog was finally in the right hands. We could see right away that Dr Casida pours her whole heart into her practice, and these innocent animals who need her.

Our 12 yr old lab mix had a large abdominal mass, and the other  vet we had been to (the ones that now seem to be in every shopping plaza) was basically like "ehh, she's had a good run, say goodbye" or you can get surgery (but was super negative about outcomes)... We felt lost and pressured to make impossible decisions at that point. Thankfully, that was not at *all* the vibe at Desert Rose.

We felt like they made our dog top priority, the communication was excellent, we left feeling like the weight was lifted off our shoulders. The facility was very nice, and the staff was compassionate and so willing to help or assist however they could.

Not only that, but the surgery and excellent care was about a third of the price of the other vet, which was further evidence that this practice has the real priority of truly caring for our furry friends, and more importantly, making care more accessible to anyone whose pets need interventions.  Our girl is three days  post-surgery,  and doing awesome! Everything went smoothly, her large incision  (for the large mass) was neatly and skillfully stitched back up, and our dog is happy and comfortable, wagging her tail and smiling again.

I'd give them more than 5 stars if I could! (We have never made a thank you card for any medical provider or veterinarian before, but felt compelled to as this was such a remarkable experience).

Just the best people in this place.

A million thanks!!

---------------------------------------------------------------
Easy to find location on the S side of Deer Valley across from the Deer Valley Airport. I'll include a pic, you will recognize the plaza! 🐶❤️ 🛩️
They are always fast, attentive, and just great all around!

I can not say enough about this place! First time patient here and my first visit alone was amazing.  They took the time to answer all my questions very thoroughly. Never once made me feel rushed during the visit. I have a big dog who has anxiety going to the vet and I love that they didn't try to force anything with him. I immediately felt very comfortable and confident in their recommendation so I booked his surgery the next morning with Dr Jennifer DePew. She did amazing and they took great care of my big guy from the very beginning.  I absolutely love this place and have already recommended to other people.  Thank you all for your help and being so kind throughout my interactions with you. I very much appreciate it!
Best team in Arizona! They absolutely love our fur babies!
We love you guys and will always recommend you!

This was our first time here. After moving back to AZ we needed to find a new vet for our dachshund, Oscar. Oscar is high anxiety/reactive to humans but mostly dogs. Everyone was super understanding and patient with him. They didn't try to upsell us on any other vaccines or anything like that. The place was very clean and in a good location. They were also able to cut his nails and do his anal glands which was super helpful. This will definitely be our new go to spot for his nails/anal gland expression and anything else Oscar needs. Look no further, THIS is the best place for your pets! Big thanks to the staff for making our experience so good :)

I have only been going to Desert Rose Animal Hospital a short time, but I am extremely happy with the care shown to me and my dog Ryder. They always take such great care of my dog, and me too. They recognize that when pets are not well, the owners are stressed and worried too. The staff is so compassionate and they truly care about the animals that are in their care.
Finally, a place the doesn't gouge for an echocardiogram! Vet & techs don't push for the unnecessary either. Knowledgeable and patient. 10/10
Had my old friend euthanized ! 😥 They are very caring and professional !
Took my sick pup in and everybody was amazing!!
Great experience. Everyone is wonderful!

Such a wonderful first time appointment/experience! Dr. Depew, Jenna, and Alex were very nice, helpful and professional! The facility is beautiful and clean, and there is plenty of parking too. This appointment confirmed my decision to have both my dogs veterinary care done at Desert Rose Animal Hospital. So happy I made that change!
Wonderful staff helped us get our pup feeling great!

My sweet boy Baker has entropion, which causes his lower eyelids to roll in irritating his eyes. Dr. Casida and her team have been so amazing in helping to create a comprehensive and long term plan for what's best for my boy. The staff always is so kind to interact with and I know they care about my kitty too. So glad to have found Desert Rose AH.

They took me right in as a walk-in and confirmed my 13 year old chihuahuas heart condition as breathing was off.  Then we scheduled surgery for full dental extractions and eye removal.  My chihuahua, Miss Piggy, is recovering nicely.  They kept me posted all day on day of surgery.

Everyone was compassionate and caring towards both Osito and us. Especially the great care everyone showed for him. I'd definitely recommend your services to all my friends with pets and if needed, I would definitely seek attention for Osito here. Thank you so much from my family and I. You were all angels during our time of need for Osito.
Thank you!
Thank you

Both Dr Casida and Dr DePugh were amazing!  They were both so caring and empathetic and really took the time to try to understand the concerns I had with my dogs. They worked together to take actionable steps to try to get to the underlying cause of the problem and were instrumental in saving my dog!!  I truly cannot thank them enough!!!
Thank you

Called the office and they got me in same day.
Doctor and staff were wonderful, highly recommend
The staff was friendly and Winnie’s dogtor was so welcoming and took the time to explain treatment paths to make sure my new puppy was in the best health
Fantastic Animal Hospital!
Wonderful first impression! Every staff member was kind and friendly and made Frannie (my golden retriever)  feel like a VIP!

They fit us in last minute for a same day sick appointment - very caring staff, clean facility, and explained all costs before charging us. Intended to go here only as a one time sick visit but this will now be my preferred vet! Thanks!

Best place to bring your furry family. They are kind,caring, knowledgeable, and have a wealth of experience. Your pet family member will get the best care possible! If you don't believe me just ask Charlie!

We took our 15 y/o fur baby in immediately felt cared for and appreciated. The Dr came in and took a seat on the ground which our nervous pup loved. Immediate trust was earned. We received a great treatment plan and received lovely follow up calls to see how the patient was doing. They are kind, caring and knowledgeable. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend them to anyone!
Thank you!
Everyone at the clinic was friendly and welcoming! They took plenty of time to get to know my dog
Very clean facility, staff is very welcoming & kind! My 1st time here, followed Dr Casida from her previous location. I trust her fully with all my furbabies! American Bully & 4 cats!
Excellent t service and bedside manner

Thank you so much guys for saving my dogs life. Overall recommend A++ They definitely care about the animals. Not the Money. I definitely recommend you taking your animals there. Desert Rose, animal Hospital 🙏 Thank you again

Highly recommend this animal hospital. The vet took great care of our FIP+ kitten. He was swollen, and close to dying. He is now halfway through his treatment and doing splendidly! Words can't express how grateful we are!
Very friendly and accommodating staff Veterinarian explains her finds & treatment plan so a pet parent can understand.
Thank you!
Thank you

1000% recommend the team here. Never once would I second guess the care my pups were being provided. The vet took the time to sit on the floor with my pup while waking up from anesthesia to ensure she was comfortable and not alone. Thats a huge deal.

Thank you Dr. Ashley Casida and staff for helping my Mooie cross the rainbow bridge. She was 15 and you made this process so comforting for me. Our animals are like family and you treated me and my Mooie with such respect and dignity! Thank you so much!

Dr. Casida is a saint. Thank you for caring, being wonderful, and someone we can count on for our pets.

I'm eternally grateful for the services rendered here.

Absolutely amazing care!!! Dr Casida sits and talks to you about your pets needs, she listens and gives you her opinion.  Leaves the ultimate decision up to you with with an educated understanding of your specific pets needs. Dr Casida is amazing!!!

I took my dog Bentley in today the place was very nice and clean.  Dr. Casida and her staff were very nice and took time to answer all my questions and concerns about my dog.  They don’t try and add a bunch of things on instead they help come up with an affordable plan.  I really like it here and so did Bentley we will be making them our primary vet.  🐶

Found Desert Rose animal hospital on the ND app. Dr Casida good and honest and fair Dr and her team is good too. If u need a vet for your fur baby try this place. Glad we did for my furry friend Zorra
Great communication and the ability to think outside the box.  I'm very pleased to have found a new vet.
Thank you

Dr. Casida and her staff are amazing! My dog was having rounds of diarrhea and was only getting worse. I called and was able to get in to see the Dr. I absolutely loved how she tried to take the least intrusive option first and not upsell me on a very expensive treatment plan and made sure my dog was treated. Dr. Casida got down on the ground with my dog to treat him and explained her thinking with the treatment plan. Sent me home with meds and he's on the road to recovery. The prices are very reasonable for the level of service received. She's gained a new patient for life!
Thank you!
Thank you!

Facility is very calming and inviting. The staff is helpful and efficient. Dr. Casida listened attentively, answered my questions, and was very engaged with my pet. The prices are very affordable as well.
Great experience every time...staff is great ,, doctor is so nice..I never feel rushed ...both cats and dogs love this place...highly recommend!!

We had the unfortunate and dreadful task of putting our sweet pitty down yesterday and I praise God we found this place.  Everything about this facility- staff, pricing, accommodations, was so above and beyond anything I've experienced.   It is clear they relate and care about pets and their owners; the pricing was what I paid to put my cat down 20 years ago!!! They are not profiting AT ALL on your horrible situation.   The room we were taken to with our dog was not a typical cold, grey examination room but a large clean and inviting (fully furnished) living room area.  We were given as much time as we needed and even some chocolates to feed her.  When all was said and done, we got a clay paw print AND they were gracious enough to get a nose and paw print with some ink I brought. I cannot stress enough how wonderful they helped make this awful day.  Thank you🩵
My mom and I had a cat that got sick and they are they're helping us get him back into the land of wellness also really great bedside manner.
Nothing but positive reviews as everyone was friendly and my dog was still happy around the staff after shots and nail trimming which she really hates as she can't stand even having her paws touched.
Thank you!
Thank you!

Dr. Cassida has been AMAZING!  We have cats and dogs at our house that are all getting older.  Desert Rose will be my new vet office from now on.  Great employees and service.  Just left there yesterday after my cat was bleeding from her mouth and needed a dental.  Also took 4 kittens there that I rescued a few months ago before adopting them out.  So happy to feel very comfortable at Desert Rose!  Thank you for everything.
C. Bridgford

So thankful that Desert Rose was there for Bentley.  Your staff is superb.  Able to schedule Bentley within a reasonable time and to ease this pet owner's anxiety.  I have such faith in Dr Casida's love and knowledge for her patients that I travel cross valley.  Bentley and Rafe love her and do not hesitate rushing in the door.

My cat, Jet, doesn't interact with anyone except a few family members. However, he loves Dr. Casida. She is able to examine him and soothe him. Dr. Casida is so caring and knowledgeable. Her support staff is great, too. The facility is very clean. I definitely recommend Dr. Casida.
Thank you!
Aside from my wife who is a veteran of the veterinary business we have not found more intelligent and caring professionals to care for our animals. We would highly recommend without reservation.

They were all very friendly and professional.  Also very sweet and caring with my dog. Plus their prices are great compared to other places I called for her cruciate ligament surgery.  I definitely recommend.
Thank you!

We love Dr Casida and the staff at Desert Rose Animal Hospital! Everyone we have interacted with has been professional and compassionate. Dr Casida takes the time to sit down and discuss any concerns. The other staff are so attentive and always helpful. We’ve taken our two cats for routine care as well as illness/injuries, and we are always treated so well. Their prices are reasonable and I don’t feel like they push extra services on us. We will be patients for life!

We took our Hank to Desert Rose because his skin was red and looked so bad. They got us in so quickly and even allowed us to be late to our first appointment due to my work schedule. I had been working in veterinary medicine for 22 years and now that I have changed professions, I was so nervous to find a new veterinary hospital. Let me tell you this is the right place. CLEAN!, smells good, beautiful lobby, nice,friendly team. Got us in a room right away and Dr came in shortly after. We spent our visit on the floor with Dr while looking at Hank and talking. Dr Casida is great. If you're in the area and need a vet dont pass this one up.
Thank you!

You folks are wonderful.  I'm very thankful Jen with Little Rascals told me about you.  I get involved with a lot of cat rescues / issues somehow and it's hard to find good, quick, companionate, affordable care.  Especially those willing to work with problem feral cats. I do not get any financial help with any of this so you are truly a blessing.  You'll be seeing me again.
Thank you!!!  Nancy Wilber

Dr. Ashley Casida, she is owner and vet.
She has been our family vet working for other vets for about 15 years.

This is the first time that she has sole owner of her own vet office

She has seen every animal that multiple family members of mine have ever owned. We’ve followed her two different vet businesses throughout the years.

Dr. Casida is the only vet that, has ever, diagnosed correctly all the time. I have a little Yorky, that always needs bladder stones removed out of her bladder. Alot of the vets, that I went to, didnt know how to remove stones or It would’ve been like three months or three week wait. Also she was misdiagnosed with bladder cancer. Dr. Casida was so sure on her diagnoses, she waved price of ultrasound to show me, my dog needed a reasonably priced procedure that would save her life.

Doctor Casita also saved my pit-bull‘s life when I was feeding her some peanut butter on a spatula and she ate the spatula. We waited for Surgery to see if this spatula, would come out the other end, but it never did. After Surgery, my dog refused to eat so she couldn’t take her medication’s. Dr. Casita is very warm hearted and loving and caring and kind and she allowed my pitbull To stay in the office with her all day and give her IV antibiotics and I took her home at night for five days following the surgery for no cost.

Dr. Casida is usually able to see you day of or next day and do the surgeries within a day or two which is a complete miracle in itself.

She’s very loving and kind when she comes in to see your pet. if they’re on the floor, she’ll sit on the floor with your animal and get to know it before she Examines the pet

I’ve been a pet owner for 30 years and I have never, ever…… had such an amazing experience with a vet before, Only Dr. Casida.

My mom now has a dog with a really bad gross mass on his neck and it might need surgery and it might not. We’re gonna do antibiotics and take a picture of it every day and then we’re gonna see if it needs more antibiotics so we’re exploring every other option besides Surgery right now.

Something very, very important to those of you, that don’t have a lot of money, is she works with every budget I mean, yes, there are things like the office visit price, but if your animal needs surgery, she’ll even go through a worksheet and see what she can do and not do to make sure that you can afford to give your animal  Surgery

She has saved my pets life 3 times  and I’m internally grateful for her and I’m so proud that she has her own vet office and I hope that whoever reads this please go and check her out and trust your pet to her care.

Snoopy made a full recovery
